improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: Steady at about 50% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 50% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
improve.coach: 40% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs. There in 60% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there. 40% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

coach.intro: Alright tuxedo_slide, 10 matches in. Let's talk patterns, the good and the growing.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
